'''R4-G2''' was an [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] in service of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Stationed on [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]], it urged Republic heroes to contact Adjudicator [[Refain]].<ref>{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=operation|Nature of Progress}}</ref>
